beschreibung: G3 (#311): Bot-Porträts, rund beschnitten im Spielerchip.
stil: Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook animal character of a fairy-tale kingdom, a regular guest at a medieval tavern gaming table: warm candlelight, rich textures, dark warm background with subtle damask pattern, gentle friendly expression with a clever twinkle, humorous but dignified, bust portrait facing the viewer, head and shoulders fully inside the image, centred with space around so it can be cropped to a circle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
ohne: text, letters, readable numbers, watermark, border, frame, modern clothing, logos, real people, celebrities, playing-card layout, weapons pointed at the viewer
